Active pen lettering: connected slanted Script 1-stroke (alt), based on the public-domain Hershey data in techninja/hersheytextjs.
Source: https://github.com/techninja/hersheytextjs/blob/master/hersheytext.json
Only the public-domain JSON stroke data is used, not the repository code. Layout, smoothing and pen animation are implemented locally.

Bundled data: signature-handwriting.json.
The repository identifies its JSON font data as public domain:
https://github.com/techninja/hersheytextjs#readme
